title: Sample-wise Constrained Learning via a Sequential Penalty Approach with Applications in Image Processing
abstract: arXiv:2601.16812v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: In many learning tasks, certain requirements on the processing of individual data samples can arguably be formalized, in an intelligible way, as strict constraints of the underlying optimization problem, rather than by means of arbitrary penalties that often require heavy trial-and-error tuning. In this paper we show that, in these scenarios, learning can be carried out exploiting a sequential penalty method that allows to explicitly deal with constraints. For the proposed algorithm we show that, under classical assumptions and in the considered learning scenario, penalty subproblems can provably be solved in finite time with suitable guarantees of approximate stationarity in expectation; we also show that, when the latter condition is guaranteed for the subproblems, the overall sequential scheme possesses almost sure convergence properties to KKT-stationary points of (general) constrained problems. The results of experiments on sand

translated_title: 基于序列惩罚方法的样本级约束学习及其在图像处理中的应用
translated_abstract: 在许多学习任务中，对单个数据样本处理的某些要求可以以一种易于理解的方式，形式化为底层优化问题的严格约束，而不是通过往往需要大量试错调参的任意惩罚项来表达。在本文中，我们证明在这些场景下，可以采用一种能够显式处理约束条件的序列惩罚方法来执行学习。针对所提出的算法，我们证明在经典假设和所考虑的学习场景下，惩罚子问题可以在有限时间内求解，并具有期望意义下近似平稳性的适当保证；我们还证明，当子问题满足上述条件时，整个序列方案对于（一般的）约束问题具有到KKT平稳点的几乎必然收敛性质。在沙地图像处理任务上的实验结果……
tldr: 提出了一种用于样本级约束学习的序列惩罚方法，证明了惩罚子问题可在有限时间内求解且整体算法几乎必然收敛到KKT平稳点，并将其应用于图像处理任务。
en_tdlr: Proposes a sequential penalty approach for sample-wise constrained learning, proving finite-time solvability of penalty subproblems and almost sure convergence to KKT-stationary points, with applications in image processing.
